integrity: All-order proof uses planar Kasteleyn signs, binary rank, a nonzero complementary minor, finite differences and Walsh inversion. Deterministic exact-integer finite checker corroborates selected instances; no independent external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Determines only the common integer divisor of all edge-signed tiling sums and parity of sharp signings in one specified family; does not classify the full Fourier support or all sharp signings. The historical comparison is bounded.
title: Sharp Walsh divisibility for Aztec-diamond domino tilings
